exports.name: HTTPClientRequest
signatures:
interface HTTPClientRequest<M extends HTTPClientRequestEvents = HTTPClientRequestEvents> {
  readonly method: HTTPMethod
  readonly path: string
  readonly headers: Record<string, string | number>
  readonly socket: TCPSocket
  readonly upgrade: boolean
  readonly headersSent: boolean
  getHeader(name: string): string | number | undefined
  getHeaders(): Record<string, string | number>
  hasHeader(name: string): boolean
  setHeader(name: string, value: string | number): void
  flushHeaders(): void
  setTimeout(ms: number, ontimeout?: () => void): this
  _write(data: unknown, encoding: StreamEncoding, cb: StreamCallback): void
  _writev(batch: { chunk: unknown; encoding: StreamEncoding }[], cb: StreamCallback): void
  _final(cb: StreamCallback): void
  readonly closed: boolean
  readonly errored: Error | null
  write(data: unknown, encoding?: BufferEncoding, cb?: StreamCallback): boolean
  end(cb?: StreamCallback): this
  cork(): void
  uncork(): void
  _open(cb: StreamCallback): void
  _predestroy(): void
  _destroy(err: Error | null, cb: StreamCallback): void
  readonly readable: boolean
  readonly writable: boolean
  readonly destroyed: boolean
  readonly destroying: boolean
  destroy(err?: Error | null): void
}

members.name: HTTPClientRequest
members.description:
An outgoing HTTP request, extending `HTTPOutgoingMessage`. Uses chunked transfer encoding
unless a `Content-Length` header is set or the method is `GET`/`HEAD`.

params.name: opts
params.description:
Request options; `method` defaults to `'GET'`, `path` to `'/'`, `host` to
`'localhost'`, and `port` to the agent's default port (`80`). Set `agent` to choose the pooling
agent, or `false` for a fresh, unpooled one.

params.name: onresponse
params.description: Added as a one-time `'response'` listener.

throws.condition: `method` or a header name is not a valid token.
`path` or a header value contains an invalid character.

members.name: headers
members.description:
The headers to send with the request, keyed by lowercase name, including an auto-generated
`host` header.

members.name: method
members.description: The request method. Defaults to `'GET'`.

members.name: path
members.description: The request path. Defaults to `'/'`.

exports.name: HTTPClientConnectionOptions
exports.description:
Options for `HTTPClientConnection`, letting a custom `IncomingMessage` subclass be used for the
response.

exports.name: HTTPClientConnection

members.name: HTTPClientConnection
members.description:
The per-socket state machine that parses response data for an `HTTPClientRequest`, and drives
its `'response'` event.

params.name: socket
params.description: The connection socket.

params.name: opts
params.description: A custom `IncomingMessage` class to use for the response.

members.name: HTTPClientConnection.for
members.description: Returns the `HTTPClientConnection` associated with `socket`, or `null` if none exists.

params.name: socket
params.description: The socket to look up.

members.name: HTTPClientConnection.from
members.description:
Returns the existing `HTTPClientConnection` for `socket`, creating one with `opts` if none
exists yet.

params.name: socket
params.description: The socket to look up or create a connection for.

params.name: opts
params.description: Options used if a new connection is created.

members.name: idle
members.description: Whether the connection currently has no in-flight request.

members.name: req
members.description: The `HTTPClientRequest` currently in flight on this connection, or `null` if none.

members.name: res
members.description: The `HTTPIncomingMessage` currently being read on this connection, or `null` if none.

members.name: socket
members.description: The underlying `TCPSocket` for this connection.

exports.description:
The `method` map of supported HTTP method names and the `status` map of status codes to their
reason phrases.

members.name: constants.HTTPMethod
members.description: A key of `constants.method`, that is one of the supported HTTP method names.

members.name: constants.HTTPStatusCode
members.description: A key of `constants.status`, that is a supported HTTP status code.

members.name: constants.HTTPStatusMessage
members.description: The reason phrase for a given `HTTPStatusCode`, as found in `constants.status`.

exports.name: HTTPError
exports.description:
An error thrown by `bare-http1` for protocol-level failures, such as an unimplemented method, a
lost connection, a suspended agent, or an invalid header. Carries a `code` identifying the
specific failure.
